transkript.t: Stop paying for these nine apps.
GitHub has a free version of every single one.
Text field, open generative AI, AI images and cinematic video with 600 plus models.
Eleven labs, voice studio, clone voices, fully local on your own machine.
Semrush open CEO, ranked tracking, backlinks and site audits in one place.
Notion app flowing, notes and docs, and it works with local AI models.
Whisper flow, open whisper, dictate into any app, even offline.
Asana open project, tasks and projects on your own server.
Calendly CalDOT DIY, book meetings synced with Google and Outlook.
Intercom, chat boot, every lead and client message in one inbox.
Loom capped, record your screen and share it in one click.
Comment repo and I'll send you all nine links.
